paper.title: Forecasting GPU Performance for Deep Learning Training and Inference
paper.public_version_note: Downloaded public PDF contains formal DOI and ASPLOS 2025 framing, 16 pages. Separate arXiv landing page identifies v3 2024-12-12; HTML abstract text differs from PDF. Raw bytes retained separately; not asserted text-identical.

reading.scope: Physical pages 2–13 body and page 14 artifact appendix before References. Page 1 abstract previously screened, introductory page not newly counted. Pages 15–16 bibliography not body-read; no cited-paper or artifact execution inferred.

findings.claim: Tile and wave decomposition with learned utilization can calibrate resource bounds; tile choices are inferred from an older profiled database, not guaranteed knowledge of new library dispatch.

Main data is FP32 under fixed old PyTorch/CUDA or ROCm. Text-generation inference measures first-token latency. AMD evaluation includes AMD training data; FP16 Tensor Core appendix-style experiment is BMM rather than complete modern models.
Measured multi-GPU tests are separate DP/TP/PP on four-GPU single-server systems, one microbatch; up-to-3840-node predictions are not validated at that scale. Artifact data/weights were not executed.

paper_to_framework_gap: Fixed main 6945927d9afcca2b9daf021f8395e53edc5b4eef, 2025-06-23; old official path redirects to scai-tech/NeuSight.
Selected MetaTable disables CUDA version filter; predictor passes cu121. Fused vector representative is last operator in selected implementation versus first in paper prose.
Selected aggregation is mutually exclusive DP/TP/PP; PP asserts one microbatch. Communication path has four-GPU count and device-specific bandwidth assumptions.
No claim of current Qwen3/DeepSeek V4/Kimi K3 runtime, service latency, mixed parallelism or whole-framework coverage.

editorial_decision.decision: 重点阅读，建议仅补 13.5.1 延伸材料
editorial_decision.placement: Existing 13.5.1 and optional calibration record within experiment 13-6 / figure 13-5; no new core section or exercise.
editorial_decision.incremental_judgment: A predictor needs version/coverage and per-stage calibration; a correct total latency may conceal wrong optimization priorities.

evidence_only_caveats: Printed sigmoid difference is not universally positive; selected wrapper clips negative predictions to zero. Independent expression counterexample does not establish failure of trained parameters.
Introduction distributed mean error 5.4% differs from evaluation 7.7%; AMD Figure 9 caption omits MI250 although plotted; historical model table should not be copied as model specifications.
scope: Selected body and code reading plus independent arithmetic; no model weights, profiling corpus, predictor, simulator or GPU execution.
